description: I'm Camilo Taborda, a software developer specializing in creating immersive and interactive web experiences. I combine modern front-end technologies with 3D, augmented reality, and artificial intelligence to build visual, functional, and user-centric solutions. My goal: to make technology empower your ideas and generate memorable digital experiences.
3d_description: Immerse yourself in the magic of interactive 3D technology. Visualize innovative projects, control the model and feel the experience like never before.
my_description_1: I’m a software developer focused on frontend development and the creation of interactive web experiences. Specialized in React, Next.js, Three.js, and React Three Fiber, I design 3D product configurators, immersive interfaces, and experiences that integrate augmented reality (AR) and artificial intelligence. My goal is to build functional, accessible, and high-performance solutions that combine technology and design to deliver unique and optimized digital experiences.
my_description_2: I’m passionate about solving complex challenges and exploring new technologies that foster my professional growth. I strive to create visually engaging applications that provide real value to users. I’m committed to continuous learning and driven by the possibilities offered by emerging tools in software development.
skillsDescription: As a software developer, I leverage modern technologies to build scalable, high-performance web applications. Expert in the JavaScript, React.js, and Next.js ecosystem, I create interactive interfaces and 3D configurators using Three.js, relying on Tailwind CSS to achieve impeccable designs. I power my developments with Supabase for robust and efficient data management, while utilizing Framer Motion and GSAP to provide each project with fluid animations. Additionally, I integrate Artificial Intelligence tools to optimize processes and enhance personalization, delivering innovative, high-quality solutions.
77RenderStudioDescription: It's 77 Render Studio, I was dedicated to developing software specialized in real estate projects, creating solutions that optimized the visualization and management of properties.
ArdataTechDescription: At Ardata Tech, we specialize in creating 3D models of products for ecommerce, allowing customers to customize their products through an interactive configurator.

portfolio_description: Welcome to my portfolio—a selection of projects built with a focus on quality, performance, and design. Here you'll find modern web applications, interactive 3D experiences, and custom configurators. Each project showcases my ability to apply advanced front-end technologies and streamline development processes using AI-powered tools, all with the goal of delivering innovative, functional, and user-centered solutions.
